description: End-to-end lifecycle for exposing LPWAN (LoRaWAN/NB-IoT) connectivity to applications, including device onboarding, connectivity profile management, session exposure, QoS control, monitoring, and rollback/recovery.

device_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the LPWAN end device (internal ID, not necessarily DevEUI/IMEI).

application_id.description: Unique identifier of an application consuming network exposure APIs.

exposure_session_id.description: Identifier for an active network exposure session between device(s) and an application.

connectivity_profile_id.description: Identifier for a connectivity profile defining LPWAN network behavior (rate limits, QoS, roaming, etc.).

policy_id.description: Identifier for a traffic/policy rule set applied within a session.

operation_id.description: Identifier for an asynchronous operation (e.g. provisioning, profile update) that can be polled or retried.

error_info.description: Common error descriptor returned by many operations.

details.description: Optional structured details of the error.

retryable.description: Indicates if the operation may be retried safely.

functions.name: register_device
functions.description: Register and onboard a new LPWAN device into the network exposure platform, including radio credentials and application bindings.

application_id.description: Application that will primarily consume data from this device.

dev_eui.description: LoRaWAN DevEUI (EUI-64), required for LoRaWAN devices.

app_key.description: LoRaWAN AppKey for OTAA; must be 16-byte hex.

nwk_key.description: LoRaWAN NwkKey for OTAA in LoRaWAN 1.1+.

abp.description: Static session keys and parameters for ABP devices.

connectivity_profile_id.description: Existing connectivity profile to bind, if any.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata such as location, asset info, tags.

asset_type.description: High-level type, e.g. sensor, tracker, meter.

asset_id.description: ID in the customer's asset management system.

async.description: If true, provisioning will be handled asynchronously and an operation_id will be returned.

functions.returns: Device registration result including device_id, initial status, optionally operation_id for async provisioning, and any validation warnings.

functions.name: create_connectivity_profile
functions.description: Create a reusable LPWAN connectivity profile that defines QoS, rate limits, roaming, and exposure behaviors.

description.description: Detailed description of the profile's purpose.

technology.description: Primary LPWAN technology this profile is targeted for.

qos.description: Quality of Service and throughput related settings.

max_uplink_messages_per_hour.description: Hard cap for uplink messages per device per hour.

allowed_regions.description: List of region codes where roaming is allowed.

default_uplink_callback.description: Default webhook callback for uplink messages.

url.description: HTTPS URL to send uplink messages to.

data_format.description: Format used when exposing payload to applications.

max_devices.description: Maximum number of devices that can be attached to this profile.

max_sessions_per_app.description: Maximum concurrent exposure sessions per application.

functions.returns: New connectivity_profile_id and full profile definition as stored.

functions.name: bind_device_to_profile
functions.description: Attach a registered device to a connectivity profile and optionally override exposure behavior.

application_id.description: Override or set application binding; if omitted, uses device default.

overrides.description: Optional device-level overrides of the profile.

uplink_callback.description: Device-specific uplink callback overriding profile default.

downlink_queue_limit.description: Maximum number of queued downlink messages for this device.

async.description: If true, returns an operation_id for asynchronous binding.

functions.returns: Binding confirmation including effective profile parameters, and optionally operation_id for async processing.

functions.name: open_exposure_session
functions.description: Open a network exposure session between one or more devices and an application, instantiating policies and callbacks.

devices.description: List of devices to attach to this exposure session.

connectivity_profile_id.description: Optional profile override for this session; otherwise uses device binding.

policies.description: Initial traffic and security policies applied to this session.

rules.description: Ordered list of rules applied to traffic.

lifecycle_events.description: Callback for lifecycle events such as device join, session close, or error.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional time-to-live; session will auto-close after this period.

functions.returns: New exposure_session_id, applied policies, effective callbacks, and initial session status.

functions.name: push_downlink_message
functions.description: Push one or more downlink messages to devices associated with an exposure session, respecting policies and rate limits.

group.description: Target group of devices. device_id and group are mutually exclusive.

by_tag.description: Send to all devices in session that have this tag.

by_profile.description: Send to all devices attached to a specific connectivity_profile_id within the session.

schedule.description: Optional scheduling settings for the downlink.

expire_after_seconds.description: Time after which unsent messages will be dropped.

correlation_id.description: Client-provided ID used to correlate delivery reports.

batch_id.description: Logical batch identifier when sending to multiple devices.

functions.returns: Acknowledgement containing queued message identifiers per target device, policy evaluation results, and any immediate rejections.

functions.name: get_exposure_session_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and health metrics of an exposure session, including policy states and device participation.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response.

functions.returns: Current session lifecycle state, device list with join status, active policies, callback configuration, and optional metrics or recent events.

functions.name: update_exposure_policies
functions.description: Modify policies for an existing exposure session, enabling dynamic QoS and access control updates.

policies.description: Policies to upsert for this session. Existing policies with same policy_name will be replaced.

policy_id.description: Existing policy_id to update; omit to create new.

remove_policy_ids.description: List of policy_ids to remove from this session.

reason.description: Reason for policy update, stored for audit.

functions.returns: Updated list of policies with their policy_ids and current enablement state, plus any conflicts or validation warnings.

functions.name: close_exposure_session
functions.description: Gracefully close an exposure session, optionally draining pending downlinks and keeping device bindings intact.

timeout_seconds.description: Used when mode=after_timeout; session will be closed after this period.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for closing the session.

notify_application.description: If true, a session_status_change event will be sent to lifecycle callback if configured.

functions.returns: Closure acknowledgement with final session state, remaining queued messages (if any), and closure timestamp.

functions.name: monitor_device_health
functions.description: Retrieve detailed health and connectivity metrics for a device, optionally within the context of a specific exposure session.

exposure_session_id.description: Optional filter to metrics within a session.

functions.returns: Device health snapshot including connectivity status, RF metrics, error events, downlink queue state, and optional timeseries data.

functions.name: list_devices
functions.description: List and filter devices registered in the LPWAN network exposure platform.

tags.description: Match devices that contain all of the given tags.

functions.returns: Paginated list of devices with summary information and cursors for subsequent pages.

functions.name: retry_operation
functions.description: Retry a previously failed or timed-out asynchronous operation such as device provisioning or binding.

retry_mode.description: Resume continues from last step; restart begins operation from scratch.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides for the original operation (e.g. new callback URL).

dry_run.description: If true, only validates retry feasibility without executing it.

functions.returns: New or updated operation status including whether retry was scheduled or executed immediately, and any new operation_id if applicable.

functions.name: rollback_configuration
functions.description: Rollback device, profile, or session configuration to a previous known-good revision.

target_id.description: ID of the entity to rollback (device_id, connectivity_profile_id, or exposure_session_id).

revision_id.description: Specific historical revision to rollback to; if omitted, the last known-good revision is used.

include_children.description: For connectivity_profile, whether to cascade rollback to bound devices' overrides.

reason.description: Reason for rollback, stored for audit trail.

functions.returns: Rollback execution result including new active revision_id, any impacted child entities, and optional operation_id for async rollbacks.

functions.name: suspend_or_resume_device
functions.description: Suspend or resume a device's network exposure, optionally within a specific session, without deprovisioning it.

reason.description: Reason for suspension/resumption, stored for audit and lifecycle callbacks.

effective_until.description: Optional time until which suspension will automatically expire.

functions.returns: Updated exposure state for the device, including whether traffic is currently allowed and any scheduled auto-resume.

functions.name: get_operation_status
functions.description: Check the current status and any error details for a long-running or asynchronous operation.

include_history.description: If true, include step-by-step execution history.

functions.returns: Operation status, including current state (pending, running, succeeded, failed), any error_info, timestamps, and optional execution history.

functions.name: search_exposure_sessions
functions.description: Faceted search across LPWAN exposure sessions with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of LPWAN exposure session summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_exposure_sessions
functions.description: Create multiple LPWAN exposure sessions in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created LPWAN exposure session ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_exposure_sessions
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many LPWAN exposure sessions with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each LPWAN exposure session, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_exposure_sessions
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many LPWAN exposure sessions in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each LPWAN exposure session, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_exposure_sessions
functions.description: Export LPWAN exposure session datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_exposure_sessions
functions.description: Bulk-import LPWAN exposure session records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated LPWAN exposure sessions.

functions.name: subscribe_to_exposure_session_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive LPWAN exposure session lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: get_exposure_session_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a LPWAN exposure session, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the LPWAN exposure session, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_exposure_session_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for LPWAN exposure sessions using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the LPWAN exposure session action.

functions.name: simulate_exposure_session_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a LPWAN exposure session without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the LPWAN exposure session, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_exposure_session_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a LPWAN exposure session change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the LPWAN exposure session under change.

functions.name: decide_exposure_session_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending LPWAN exposure session approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: add_exposure_session_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a LPWAN exposure session for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: upload_exposure_session_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a LPWAN exposure session with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: create_exposure_session_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a LPWAN exposure session (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the LPWAN exposure session version captured.

functions.name: restore_exposure_session_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a LPWAN exposure session from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: get_exposure_session_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for LPWAN exposure sessions over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the LPWAN exposure session domain context.

functions.name: get_exposure_session_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for LPWAN exposure sessions combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the LPWAN exposure session context.

functions.name: create_exposure_session_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to LPWAN exposure sessions with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current LPWAN exposure sessions.

functions.name: evaluate_exposure_session_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a LPWAN exposure session in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: get_exposure_session_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a LPWAN exposure session including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the LPWAN exposure session, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_exposure_session_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a LPWAN exposure session and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: assign_exposure_session_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a LPWAN exposure session with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the LPWAN exposure session with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_exposure_sessions
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more LPWAN exposure sessions, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each LPWAN exposure session.

functions.name: compare_exposure_session_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a LPWAN exposure session with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the LPWAN exposure session, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_exposure_session_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to LPWAN exposure session operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of LPWAN exposure session operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_exposure_session_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a LPWAN exposure session and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the LPWAN exposure session, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_exposure_session
functions.description: Clone a LPWAN exposure session into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned LPWAN exposure session record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_exposure_session_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted LPWAN exposure session report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the LPWAN exposure session window covered.

functions.name: escalate_exposure_session
functions.description: Escalate a LPWAN exposure session to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the LPWAN exposure session.
